propositions: Operators inspecting detailed review evidence cannot currently see plan-material-pin health, drift status, enforcement posture, and phase compatibility without independent status string recreation.
Audit rendering, CLI show, MCP detail, web UI, and close-error handlers must consume the canonical DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract rather than defining duplicate status logic.

Pin enforcement-disabled drift must display as advisory while legacy-unpinned and current-no-relationships remain clearly distinguished; ordinary list output and persisted ticket events must not change.
Output schemas and golden-path tests require updates to reflect plan_review_health in detailed renderers while preserving lean list behavior and rollback compatibility.
Advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles without adding basic-user-facing documentation.
